notes: Pilgrims' Temple — biomes. 14 biomes picked per floor from the levelBiomes table in world.json (run-seeded, so runs differ), desaturated palettes, litter categories (shared rubble + uniques like vines/mushroom caps), generationMethod rooms vs cavern (cellular automata), special enemies per biome, and slate-blue ambience lines every 30-60 turns. eligibleLevelRange is advisory fallback only.

biomes.name: Crypt
ambience: Cold drafts curl through the crypt aisles.
Distant stone lids grind against their sarcophagi.
A faint incense of old myrrh hangs in the air.
Footsteps echo too long in the vaulted dark.
Candle smoke ghosts along the low arches.
Water drips somewhere beyond the pillars, patient and cold.
An unlit censer sways faintly, though no hand touched it.
Mortar dust sifts from the vault above, catching dim light.

biomes.name: Ossuary
ambience: Bones whisper as dust shifts across the ossuary.
A hollow clatter rolls from stacked skulls.
Chalky air catches in your throat.
Shadows pool between leaning bone-columns.
Something small scuttles among the remains.
A femur settles with a soft, tired crack.
Dry air tastes of chalk and old marrow.
Pale skulls watch with empty, patient sockets.

biomes.name: Fungal Grove
ambience: Spores drift like pale snow through fungal gloom.
Mushroom caps pulse with faint light.
The air is thick, sweet, and slightly sour.
Soft caps sigh as you brush past.
Mycelial threads hum beneath the floor.
A damp, earthy perfume clings to every breath.
Distant caps release a soft puff of glowing dust.
The floor gives slightly, spongy with hidden growth.

biomes.name: Jungle Overgrowth
ambience: Vines tighten overhead with a soft creak.
Humid air beads on cold stone.
Leaves rustle where no wind should reach.
A distant vine snaps taut, then stills.
Roots have cracked the temple walls below.
Warm rot and green perfume hang heavy in the air.
Something unseen pushes through tangled fronds.
Moss muffles your steps like a living carpet.

biomes.name: Cinder Chapel
ambience: Ash drifts on heat that has no source.
Cinder clicks underfoot, cooling and cracking.
A low draft carries the tang of soot.
Embers blink in the dark like tired eyes.
Stone sweats with old, trapped heat.
Cracked tiles tick as they cool in the dark.
A faint, acrid haze stings the eyes.
Distant stone sighs as heat shifts through old flues.

biomes.name: Gatehouse
ambience: Chains clink somewhere above the gate arch.
Booted feet once marched these flagstones daily.
A rusted portcullis hangs crooked in its slot.
Watch-bells hang silent, tongueless with age.
Cold air funnels through the murder holes.

biomes.name: Cells
ambience: Empty manacles chime softly in the dark.
Straw pallets molder in the corners.
Scratch marks count days on the cell doors.
A draft moans through the barred slots.
Someone long gone still paces here, or seems to.

biomes.name: Warren
ambience: Burrow mouths pock the soft walls.
Something gnaws steadily, out of sight.
The tunnels branch wrong, like a maze half-dug.
Loose earth sifts from the low ceiling.
Small eyes blink and vanish down side holes.

biomes.name: Sunken Chapel
ambience: Black water laps at the sunken flagstones.
Drowned candles float, still somehow lit.
Your steps echo back a half-beat late.
Algae slicks the lower steps.
Bells toll dully from below the waterline.

biomes.name: Archive
ambience: Scroll dust hangs thick as curtain gauze.
Shelf rows lean like tired mourners.
A page turns somewhere, with no hand to turn it.
Ink and mildew sweeten the stale air.
Whispers file themselves between the stacks.

biomes.name: Sanctum
ambience: Candle rows burn for no congregation.
Kneel-worn stone dips before the altar.
A choir hums one note, then stops.
Incense smoke spells slow letters upward.
The hush here feels listened-to.

biomes.name: Infernal Chapel
ambience: Brimstone sweat beads on the black stone.
Chains hang in lengths, swaying without wind.
A deep furnace breath warms the floor grates.
Scorch marks climb the walls like ivy.
Far below, something vast turns over.

biomes.name: Throne Room
ambience: A throne of fused bone overlooks the hall.
Moth-eaten banners remember old victories.
The carpet path is worn by centuries of knees.
A crown of black glass sits empty, waiting.
Courtier ghosts hold their last positions.

biomes.name: Abyssal Rift
ambience: The dark below has a texture, like oil.
Your light bends inward at the rift edge.
Echoes return saying things you did not say.
Cold rises in slow, deliberate waves.
Stars of pale fungus mark the far wall.
